title: garm-provider-docker extra_specs
description: The pool/scale-set extra_specs contract for garm-provider-docker (ADR-005). extra_specs is the GARM-admin trust tier: narrower and more dynamic than the operator's provider config, and read from the stdin BootstrapInstance.extra_specs field (never GARM_POOL_EXTRASPECS, which is empty for scale sets). Only the fields below are accepted; any other property is rejected (additionalProperties:false), which is what structurally keeps a raw image reference, docker_host, the privileged flag, or a managed Docker label out of this channel. Every accepted field is further bounded at CreateInstance time against the live provider config: dind_mode by allowed_dind_modes, runner_memory/dind_memory by the configured ceiling (positive-only, rejected not clamped if exceeded), and flavor by the [flavors.*] map. extra_env is governed by an OPERATOR ALLOWLIST (config [extra_specs].allowed_env, default EMPTY/fail-closed): only allowlisted NAMES may be set, each name must match the env-name charset ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, and a hard-reserved set (RUNNER_*, DOCKER_*, GARM_*, ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_*, JIT_CONFIG_ENABLED, GITHUB_URL, RUN_AS_ROOT, WAIT_FOR_DOCKER_SECONDS, BASH_ENV, ENV, IFS, PATH, LD_*, NODE_OPTIONS) is rejected even if allowlisted; provider-injected environment always wins.

flavor.description: Name of a [flavors.<name>] entry in the provider config. This is the ONLY channel that varies the runner image per pool (ADR-002/ADR-005); extra_specs never accepts a raw image reference. An unknown flavor name is rejected at CreateInstance time.

dind_mode.description: The Docker-in-Docker mode this pool requests (ADR-001). Bounded by the operator's allowed_dind_modes ceiling: a mode outside that list is rejected, so a pool can select within the operator's allowed set but never escalate beyond it.

runner_memory.description: Runner container memory limit as a human byte size (e.g. "4GiB", "512MiB", "2GB"). Must be POSITIVE: a zero value in any representation ("0", "0GiB", "0 B") is rejected, because Docker treats a 0 memory limit as UNSET, which would silently remove the operator's ceiling (H1). Bounded by the effective configured runner_memory: a request exceeding the operator's ceiling is rejected (reject-not-clamp, owner ruling), not silently reduced.

dind_memory.description: DinD sidecar memory limit as a human byte size. Must be POSITIVE (a zero value is rejected, same as runner_memory — H1). Bounded by the effective configured dind_memory exactly like runner_memory; unused when the effective dind_mode is "none".

storage_driver.description: The explicit --storage-driver dockerd flag for the DinD sidecar (ADR-001). Defaults to the configured storage_driver when omitted.

runner_labels.description: Additional GitHub Actions runner labels, appended to the runner's label set. Takes effect only in non-JIT delivery mode; in JIT mode GARM bakes the label set into the runner config server-side, so these are inert there.

extra_env.description: Extra environment variables for the runner container. Each NAME must match a strict env-name charset ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (H3): a key containing '=', whitespace, unicode, or a leading digit is rejected, so a key like "JIT_CONFIG_ENABLED=false" can never smuggle a value past the exact-name reserved/allowlist checks and the provider-wins merge. Beyond the charset, extra_env is governed by an operator ALLOWLIST (config [extra_specs].allowed_env, default EMPTY): a name not on the allowlist is rejected at CreateInstance time (H2). Hard-reserved names (RUNNER_*, DOCKER_*, GARM_*, ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_*, JIT_CONFIG_ENABLED, GITHUB_URL, RUN_AS_ROOT, WAIT_FOR_DOCKER_SECONDS, BASH_ENV, ENV, IFS, PATH, LD_*, NODE_OPTIONS) are rejected even if allowlisted. A non-reserved allowlisted name that merely collides with a provider-injected variable is dropped in favor of the provider's value — provider-injected environment always wins the merge.
